identification: TASK-LOCAL MODIFIED INVOCATION CODE per author017/018/019. NOT stock CLI functionality. No installed byte is modified; the pinned installed input is only read and verified. Supported invocation is the native headless prompt entry reached through the installed launcher (bin/zcode.mjs) or the pinned agent entry directly. The workspace/protocol createRecord construction route (minified jkt/createWorkspaceZCodeApp, request-client VWo header fallback) is EXCLUDED from the supported invocation; it is not patched, and the T2 guard fails closed (ALLOWLIST_NOT_BOUND) if an app constructed through it ever reaches a turn in this process.

installed_entry.realpath_note: runtime\current is a junction to releases\<version>; both spellings are admitted as the same pinned file (bytes+sha256 verified through the junction path).

installed_wrapper.role: installed launcher; for non-web argv it rewrites process.argv[1] to the pinned agent entry and imports it in-process. The exact launch recipe response-only-zcode.cmd invokes this wrapper with the single added --require preload, mirroring the installed zcode.cmd byte-for-byte otherwise.

transforms.purpose: Native headless app construction site A. Binds invocation-local runtimeConfig.toolAllowlist=[] ahead of the mode/disallowlist spreads (the site has no toolAllowlist source of its own). The site receives its standalone providerRuntimeHeadersPort from the pre-built installed runtime (z.providerRuntimeHeadersPort), which is preserved unchanged; authentication port, model selection and session identity are not touched.
Native headless app construction site B (projectConfigPath variant; standalone providerRuntimeHeadersPort from pre-built runtime It). Same insertion rule as T1b.

Inside the turn executor, AFTER 'await this.initializeMcp(...)' (deferred MCP registration completes first) and BEFORE the model request: assert session config binds toolAllowlist===[], the model-callable list g is empty, AND the registered registry itself is empty (counted via toContracts/list, fail-closed on an unrecognized registry API). Missing shim => TypeError => turn aborts. Violation => thrown ZRO117 error => prompt prevented, attempt closes honestly. Stock unavailable-tool dispatch already fails closed (ToolNotFound, recoverable:false) for any name absent from this registry.

capture_contract: MANDATORY exclusive capture: ZRO117_CAPTURE_FILE must be an absolute path; the file is claimed with O_WRONLY|O_CREAT|O_EXCL at startup (occupied/wrong-target claim failures are fatal exit 7); every event line is written through the held descriptor and any write failure is fatal exit 7. There is no stderr-only fallback for required capture (stderr remains a mirror only). Absent ZRO117_CAPTURE_FILE is itself fatal (CAPTURE_NOT_CONFIGURED).
test_sentinel: ZRO117_ASSERT_MODE=verify-once-then-exit (test-only, never set by the launch recipe): after the first verified-OK guard call the process records a dispatch probe against the real registry and exits 0 BEFORE any provider request. Violations still throw; the sentinel never bypasses a failed check.
notes: Invocation-local only: transforms mutate the in-memory source string passed to Module.prototype._compile for the pinned entry exactly once per process; no file is written; the restriction lives solely in the in-memory runtimeConfig object and is never persisted.

Both admitted entry spellings (junction and realpath) plus a basename+realpath fallback are matched; the r002 draft's basename prefilter regressed fixture pins and is corrected here (direct comparisons first).

Corrected r002 sidecar conflation: VWo is the workspace/protocol route's request-client provider-header fallback, not 'the standalone authentication'. The supported headless sites' standalone authentication port is the providerRuntimeHeadersPort built by the installed runtime and passed at both sites; it is preserved byte-identically.
